sources.entry: grocy - ERP beyond your fridge. Groceries & household management solution for your home. (Demo, Source Code) MIT PHP/Docker
Grocy | ERP for your kitchen: groceries, chores and household management

summary.one_liner: Grocy is a self-hosted, web-based groceries and household management app (an "ERP for your fridge") covering stock, shopping, meal plans and chores.
summary.what_it_does: Grocy is a PHP web application for managing a household's groceries and chores, backed by SQLite. The README describes features such as stock tracking, a shopping list, meal planning and a chores overview, shown in its screenshot sections. It includes a REST API with an integrated Swagger UI at /api, which the web frontend itself uses. Products can be added by barcode, either by typing or scanning with a USB barcode reader or device camera, and by looking them up via an external service; a plugin for Open Food Facts is included and enabled by default. Feature flags in the config can hide unused areas such as chores, and users can add custom CSS or JS without modifying the app. The README notes German and English localization, with translations handled through Transifex.
use_cases: track household groceries and stock levels
scan product barcodes to add items
how_to_run: Copy config-dist.php to data/config.php and edit to your needs
Ensure the data directory is writable
Point the webserver root to the public directory
Open the app and log in as admin/admin, then change the password immediately
Alternatively, use the Docker instructions on the website (README gives no commands)
notable: Barcode scanning via USB barcode readers or the device camera, using ZXing client-side
Built-in REST API documented with Swagger UI
Optional Open Food Facts barcode lookup plugin
Feature flags to disable unused modules like chores
Custom CSS/JS injection via data/custom_css.html and data/custom_js.html
caveats: Camera barcode scanning requires a secure (HTTPS) connection due to browser restrictions
Database migrations are only supported between releases, not between master commits
RTL languages are not yet supported
Developer describes it as a hobby project with no support beyond the issue tracker and subreddit
